CHIEF COMPLAINT
Follow-up of chronic problems.

HISTORY OF PRESENT ILLNESS
Anna is a 44-year-old female with past medical history significant for arthritis, gout, and reflux who presents today for follow-up. Last seen approximately 6 months ago. She reports that her arthritis has been improving. She has been doing pilates and lifting weights, which has helped build muscle and reduce joint pain. She completed physical therapy for her right knee with good results and reports improved strength and ability to ambulate. She is currently walking 1 to 1.5 miles per day. Regarding gout, she had an episode of right first big toe gout approximately 2 months ago that improved with medication. She is currently taking allopurinol with no issues and denies further flare-ups. For reflux, she was started on omeprazole and dietary modifications. She reports continued symptoms including morning vomiting and abdominal pain. She also endorses bloating. Denies weight loss, fever, or chills. Last bowel movement was 2 days ago and was normal with no blood.

REVIEW OF SYSTEMS
Positive for nausea, vomiting (morning vomiting specifically), abdominal pain, and abdominal distension. Denies fever, chills, weight loss, and diarrhea.
